reuse.why: Uses existing getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages, NO_TEMPLATE_SQL, isTrackingBudget and the mutator/undoable registration; no shared category-selection helper exists to reuse.

duplication.why: Copies the month-wide category-selection SQL and the income/tracking skip loop verbatim from set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg, adding a fifth copy instead of extracting one.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler type/registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and consistent with neighbours, but the category rule now has another copy that must be kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared selection abstraction exists; existing helpers (getSheetValue, setBudget, NO_TEMPLATE_SQL) are used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied selection query and skip loop in setLastMonthSpending are verbatim copies of set3MonthAvg's, not disguised.
